It’s thought the giant marine reptile looked like a porpoise or a dolphin, and this specific species, Ichthyotitan Severnensis, would have been about the size of a blue whale. Dr Dean Lomax from the University of Manchester, who worked on identifying this giant species, tells Tech & Science Daily the story behind the discovery, and explains how significant it is.
